title: Tuning Stability by Instrument
dataSources: Yousician lessons (`yousician:lesson`), Simply Piano practice (`simplypiano:session`), TonalEnergy tuning (`tonalenergy:tuning`), Pro Metronome sessions (`prometronome:session`), and forScore practice (`forscore:practice`).
app: Yousician lessons, Simply Piano practice, TonalEnergy tuning logs, Pro Metronome sessions, and forScore sheet-music practice exports ingested into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tonalenergy:tuning cents_off=* instrument_name=*
| stats avg(abs(cents_off)) as avg_abs_cents_off, max(abs(cents_off)) as worst_abs_cents_off by instrument_name
| sort - avg_abs_cents_off
description: Ranks instruments by average and worst deviation from pitch center across tuning checks.
value: Tuning stability reveals which instruments, strings, reeds, or environments need attention before practice becomes frustrating.
implementation: Log TonalEnergy checks per instrument and compare average absolute cents-off deviation across sessions.
visualization: Table of instruments with average and worst absolute cents off.
grandmaExplanation: It watches which instruments drift out of tune the most.
